CustomField.label: Absence
CustomField.description: SCRUM-457 AC2/AC3: the one line the customer page shows — who is absent from when to until when and which colleague covers. Populated ONLY while the absence covers today (Start <= today <= End); blank outside the absence, so the customer page looks exactly as it does today (AC3). A future absence is deliberately not shown here — it belongs to the team-lead overview (AC8), not to the customer page.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_Start__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_End__c)) && Absence_Start__c <= TODAY() && Absence_End__c >= TODAY(), "Abwesent " & TEXT(Absence_Start__c) & " until " & TEXT(Absence_End__c) & " - Deputy: " & IF(ISBLANK(Absence_Deputy__c), "OHNE", Absence_Deputy__c), "")
